card.name: Verb right after asking for help
card.fires_on: The word or particle right after a help-seeking phrase such as "Need help", "help them to fill" or "assistance with". It is strongest on "identifying" in the MedTerms footer "Need help identifying pills and medications?".

modes.label: MedTerms footer
modes.description: The word "identifying" in the repeated "Need help identifying pills" footer of a medical dictionary page.

modes.label: Help plus particle or verb
modes.description: A verb or particle that completes a phrase about helping or assisting someone with a task.
modes.example: who needed someone to help them to fill<< out>> simple applications.

card.plain: It fires on the word that follows someone asking for or giving help, mostly the "Need help identifying pills" footer.
